title: Did not last long
text: Did not last long. I have bought this style gravity mill before, and they were good for a couple of years. This one began malfunctioning at about six months!

product_metadata.title: Electric Pepper Grinder Salt Mill Gravity Control Shaker Automatic Operated Battery Powered Large Capacity Transparent Lid Adjustable Coarseness with Led Light (1Silver)
features: 【Gravity Control】This upgraded electric pepper grinder features an advanced gravity sensing design that allows one-handed operation without the use of a switch button. You only need to tilt the 45-degree black pepper grinder down and it will start automatically. Return to vertical stop working. The refillable pepper grinder is three times more efficient than a manual pepper grinder.

【Adjustable Coarseness】This salt grinder has a high-quality ceramic grinding core, in addition to supporting different grinding coarseness settings to meet you want. it also has a high wear resistance and a longer service life. Battery powered, each electric pepper mill requires 6 AAA batteries (batteries not included).

【Premium Materials】The container of this sea salt grinder has a big and wide mouth design that is easy to refill sea salt and spices; Antioxidant body keeps spices fresh and healthy, and it is more durable than glass; Large capacity makes you no need to refill your salt grinder often.

【Unique Design】Transparent acrylic material at the bottom allows you to see the remaining spices and convenient to distinguish the spices in the grinder. With the blue LED light, blue light is not only bright but also gentle, you can easily to see amount of pepper, salt and other grain you put in your food.

【Wide Applicability】 The salt and pepper grinder set is suitable for pepper, salt and other solid grain seasonings. Battery powered, convenient and fast, you can use it anytime and anywhere. This electric salt and pepper grinder is the good helper for kitchens, restaurants, parties and outdoor picnics.
